column1: # title: TMDS lost with 5V held (source mode change): clock lost + SCDT off
# HPD toward the source stays high. RX 0x07 bits 2:0 then re-latch every poll while 5V is present
# without TMDS (traced 07 each cycle in S31 t=24728.6-26732.5); RD only acknowledges them.
# columns: n op dev bank reg mask value note
# ops: W write value; M read-modify-write: new = (old & ~mask) | (value & mask); R read (value: traced example or '-');
#      P poll until (reg & mask) == value (interval/timeout in note); D delay, value = ms; X step described in the chapter
# dev: 8-bit I2C address. bank: 0x58 bank 0-1, 0x70 bank 0-3, '-' unbanked device, '*' the bank register 0x0f itself
# value: hex; {read} = write back the value read from this register earlier in the table (W1C acknowledge);
#        {expr} = computed, variables defined in the chapter; '/' is integer division
# note: 'cond:' marks a conditional row; 'RD: RMW mask ff' = RD reads first, a plain write is equivalent
